title: n8n expression errors with 'Multiple matching items for expression' after an Aggregate or Merge
symptoms: ERROR: Multiple matching items for expression
ERROR: Info for expression missing from previous node
Expression resolves to null with a note that the node is on another branch
cause: $('Node').item follows each item back through the item links, and that thread breaks after nodes that combine items, after Code nodes that drop pairing, or across merged branches.
fix: Use .first(), .last() or .all()[index] when you know the position, or set pairedItem in Code node output so links survive.
apply:
{{ $('Get customer').first().json.email }}
